question.text: Konark Growth Fund (continued): what is the DPI (Distributions to Paid-In) ratio?

explanation.text: The Logic: DPI = Cumulative Distributions / Capital Called = INR 144 / INR 120 = 1.20x. This measures CASH returned to LPs — the realisation metric. The Trap: A is RVPI; C is TVPI; D is arbitrary. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A and XIX-C test DPI. LPs benchmark PE/VC GPs on DPI net of carry.
